The rollout is now complete and healthy.

## Root cause

Deployment `default/app` (revision 2) added a pod-level `nodeSelector: disktype=ssd`. The only node in the cluster (`benchmark-node-selector-no-match-…-control-plane`) has no `disktype` label, so the new ReplicaSet `app-77bd4fcf9c` pod stayed `Pending`:

```
Warning  FailedScheduling  0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector.
```

The Deployment's own status confirmed the stuck state: `replicas: 4`, `updatedReplicas: 1`, `unavailableReplicas: 1`, with the Progressing condition stuck on `ReplicaSetUpdated`. Revision 1 differed only by the absence of that selector — the image, ports, replicas and strategy were identical, and the pre-existing pods were running that same image fine, so the selector was the sole faulty field.

## Change made

One field removed from the owning resource (minimal, targeted):

```
kubectl -n default patch deploy app --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/template/spec/nodeSelector"}]'
deployment.apps/app patched
```

Replicas (3), image (`nginx:1.31.5`), ports, strategy and progress deadline were left untouched; no nodes were labeled and nothing was deleted or restarted.

## Verified outcome

- `kubectl rollout status deploy/app` → `deployment "app" successfully rolled out`
- Desired vs. actual now match: `replicas=3 updated=3 ready=3 available=3 unavailable=<none>`, `generation=3 observedGeneration=3` (controller has seen and reconciled the change)
- Progressing condition: `ReplicaSet "app-575b7496bc" has successfully progressed.` / reason `NewReplicaSetAvailable`; Available condition still `MinimumReplicasAvailable`
- Surplus old ReplicaSet `app-77bd4fcf9c` scaled to `0`; all 3 pods `Running` with `Ready=True`, image `nginx:1.31.5` (the intended image), no Pending pods remain
- Functional check through the app: `http=200` from `curl http://localhost:80/` inside a pod
- No new `FailedScheduling` events after the patch (the listed ones are pre-fix, from before the change)

The rollout is now complete and healthy.

## Root cause

Deployment `default/app` (revision 2) added a pod-level `nodeSelector: disktype=ssd`. The only node in the cluster (`benchmark-node-selector-no-match-…-control-plane`) has no `disktype` label, so the new ReplicaSet `app-77bd4fcf9c` pod stayed `Pending`:

```
Warning  FailedScheduling  0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector.

The Deployment's own status confirmed the stuck state: `replicas: 4`, `updatedReplicas: 1`, `unavailableReplicas: 1`, with the Progressing condition stuck on `ReplicaSetUpdated`. Revision 1 differed only by the absence of that selector — the image, ports, replicas and strategy were identical, and the pre-existing pods were running that same image fine, so the selector was the sole faulty field.

## Change made

One field removed from the owning resource (minimal, targeted):

```
kubectl -n default patch deploy app --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/template/spec/nodeSelector"}]'
deployment.apps/app patched
```

Replicas (3), image (`nginx:1.31.5`), ports, strategy and progress deadline were left untouched; no nodes were labeled and nothing was deleted or restarted.

## Verified outcome

- `kubectl rollout status deploy/app` → `deployment "app" successfully rolled out`
- Desired vs. actual now match: `replicas=3 updated=3 ready=3 available=3 unavailable=<none>`, `generation=3 observedGeneration=3` (controller has seen and reconciled the change)
- Progressing condition: `ReplicaSet "app-575b7496bc" has successfully progressed.` / reason `NewReplicaSetAvailable`; Available condition still `MinimumReplicasAvailable`
- Surplus old ReplicaSet `app-77bd4fcf9c` scaled to `0`; all 3 pods `Running` with `Ready=True`, image `nginx:1.31.5` (the intended image), no Pending pods remain
- Functional check through the app: `http=200` from `curl http://localhost:80/` inside a pod
- No new `FailedScheduling` events after the patch (the listed ones are pre-fix, from before the change)
